lemma fundamental_theorem_of_variational_calculus' {f : Y → V}
    (μ : Measure Y) [IsFiniteMeasureOnCompacts μ] [μ.IsOpenPosMeasure]
    [OpensMeasurableSpace Y]
    (hf : Continuous f) (hg : ∀ g, IsTestFunction g → ∫ x, ⟪f x, g x⟫_ℝ ∂μ = 0) :
    f = 0 := by
  funext x
  apply inner_self_eq_zero'.mp
  have h : ∀ v : V, ⟪f x, v⟫_ℝ = 0 := by
    intro v
    have hzero : (fun y => ⟪f y, v⟫_ℝ) = 0 := by
      apply Continuous.eq_zero_of_forall_integral_eq_zero
        (Continuous.inner' f (fun _ => v) hf continuous_const)
      intro φ hφ
      have := hg (fun y => φ y • v) (IsTestFunction.smul_right hφ contDiff_const)
      simpa [inner_smul_right'] using this
    exact congr_fun hzero x
  exact h (f x)
